games.title: Wildlings
games.fullTitle: Wildlings: Why is There a Zoo in Bazooka
games.role: Concept, game design, level design, development
games.blurb: Blast yourself across one giant level with a bazooka. No jumps. Just recoil, traps and bad decisions.
games.description: Blast yourself with a bazooka across one giant rage-filled level in this brutal physics platformer. Mix and match animal heads and bodies, master precision recoil, and survive deadly traps. No mercy. No jumps. Just you, a bazooka, and bad decisions.

contributions.title: Game design
contributions.text: Designed the unique bazooka-based physics mechanics and challenging level structure.

contributions.title: Unity development
contributions.text: Implemented the core gameplay systems and physics interactions.

contributions.title: UI design
contributions.text: Created an engaging and intuitive user interface for the game.

games.title: Ant March Adventure
games.blurb: Lead a growing ant colony through 10 randomised levels. Every run, every choice, a different colony.
games.description: A roguelike mobile game where players lead a growing ant colony through 10 randomised, increasingly difficult levels. Command your ant army as you navigate through procedurally generated environments, collecting resources and facing escalating challenges. Each run offers a unique experience, with strategic decisions that determine the survival and growth of your colony.

contributions.title: Game design
contributions.text: Designed the core systems and mechanics that make each run unique and engaging.

contributions.title: Lead development
contributions.text: Mentored and directed the development team to bring the vision to life.

contributions.title: UI/UX design
contributions.text: Crafted an intuitive and accessible interface for mobile players.

games.title: Road Rush Puzzle
games.blurb: Lay road tiles fast enough to keep a speeding car alive. Quick thinking, spatial puzzles, a ticking clock.

media.storeVideo: none found on Play Store or App Store listing (checked 20 Oct)

games.description: A fast-paced puzzle game where players build roads to guide a speeding car to its destination. Test your quick thinking and spatial awareness as you strategically place road tiles to create the perfect path. Race against time and overcome challenging obstacles to complete each level and master the art of road building.

contributions.title: Game design
contributions.text: Designed the core gameplay mechanics and progression systems.

contributions.title: 3D art
contributions.text: Created all visual assets to bring the game world to life.

contributions.title: UI/UX design
contributions.text: Crafted an intuitive and engaging user experience.

games.title: Zen Puzzle Saga
games.role: Concept, design, art, music and sound
games.blurb: Two orbs, Yin and Yang, move as mirror images with every swipe. Guide both past spikes and traps until they meet.
games.description: Welcome to Zen Puzzle Saga, the relaxing yet challenging puzzle game! Step into a world of balance, where Yin and Yang orbs move in perfect reflection every time you swipe. Guide these twin orbs through spiked edges, tricky walls and cunning traps until they unite on the sacred Harmony tile.

contributions.title: Game design
contributions.text: Crafted the core mirror-movement mechanic and level progression, balancing puzzle difficulty from beginner to expert.
bullets: Designed mirrored orb controls and reflection rules

contributions.title: Game art
contributions.text: Established a minimalist “Zen” aesthetic (clean lines, a calming colour palette and ambient UI) to enhance focus and relaxation.
bullets: Designed Yin and Yang orb sprites
Created tilemap assets and UI icons
Composed subtle animations for smooth feedback

contributions.title: Sound design
contributions.text: Created the music from scratch with a relaxing mood.

games.title: Sweet Shot
games.blurb: Guide candies from the factory pipeline into the jar. Every level adds a new obstacle to time and outsmart.
games.description: A hyper-casual game with puzzle elements, made for mobile. Step into the world of candy making, where you control the flow of delicious candies from the factory pipeline to the jar. Guide colourful candies through tricky factory pipelines and land them perfectly in the jar. But beware: each level is filled with unique challenges and obstacles that test your strategy and timing!

contributions.title: Unity development
contributions.text: The game has some unique mechanics that I loved implementing.

contributions.title: Game design
contributions.text: I loved designing the levels for this game, as it challenged me to create an immersive flow throughout.

games.title: Storm Alert
games.status: Proof of concept, University of Tartu
games.blurb: Your home, right before a real crisis. Gather supplies, decide under pressure, and work out who to call when things go wrong.

media.artNote: 1 = key art illustration; 2-9 = gameplay screenshots from Ahmed (21 Oct)

games.description: An interactive narrative about emergency preparedness that puts you at home right before a real crisis. Gather supplies, make decisions under pressure, and figure out who to call when things go wrong. Your choices determine how you and your household make it through the storm.

games.title: Magic Mineral
games.role: Concept, design, art direction, Unity development
games.blurb: A dark cave, a dimming light, and magic that both helps and haunts you. Find the crystal that could save your village.
games.description: Explore a dangerous cave with a very limited, dimming light, and experience the magic that both helps and haunts you. A top-down 2D survival game where you need to find a magic crystal that could save your village.

contributions.title: Game design
contributions.text: This is an ongoing project, but the overall design of the enemies and player abilities has been finalised.
bullets: Enemy behaviour and player ability design

contributions.title: Game art
contributions.text: This was the most interesting part of my work, and my favourite. I wanted a unique look across the whole game, and a scary dungeon atmosphere made of light and darkness.
bullets: Shader creation with Unity Shader Graph

contributions.title: Programming (Unity)
contributions.text: Programming-wise, this is a demanding job given the scale of the game. I have designed and developed the main systems, but still need to implement the rest of the enemies.

games.title: The Unwanted
games.role: Concept, narrative, hand-drawn art, Unity development
games.blurb: Take a helpless ghost back to the forest, past every challenge on the way.
games.description: Can you take the helpless ghost back to the forest and pass all the challenges on the way? A point-and-click adventure made as a project for the Advanced Game Development course in the Digital Learning Games programme at Tallinn University.

contributions.title: Game design
contributions.text: The main objective of this game was to design a point-and-click adventure with puzzle elements. The narrative of this game is very close to me.

contributions.title: Game art
contributions.text: The game art was made from scratch. I kept a stylised, personal look across the game because it tells an emotional story. That is why I chose the hand-drawn style.

contributions.title: Programming (Unity)
contributions.text: The logic for this game was simple, but the game had to stay persistent across scenes. I learned some advanced architecture while making it.

games.title: Trapped
games.blurb: A cave, a father who never lets you leave, and one question: how far will you go?

media.artNote: card = 16:9 render of the itch banner art (art-src/card.html); 1-3 = game screenshots (24 Oct)

games.description: You are Ti. You live in a cave with your father, Vigor, and you are never allowed to leave. How far will you go? A short interactive story with two endings, made with Twine for the Interactive Storytelling course in the Digital Learning Games programme at Tallinn University.

games.title: After the End
games.blurb: Humans left a dead Earth behind. As one of the last bees, pollinate what you can and dodge acid rain and mutants.
games.description: Made for the Ludum Dare 53 game jam, on the theme “Delivery”. The humans have left Earth, leaving a dead planet behind. The few surviving plants and animals are now dying from high levels of pollution. Yet hope remains. You are one of the last surviving bees on the planet, searching for other members of your tribe. Are they alive? To survive, pollinate as many flowers as you can so the plants can repopulate and fix the Earth. But beware! Earth is not what it was before: it is filled with pollutants, acid rain and mutant species. Do not spend too long in polluted areas; come out for fresh air.

games.title: The Return
games.status: Game jam: Global Game Jam, Pärnu
games.blurb: A journey where Mother Nature waits for “The Run” to return to its roots.
games.description: Embark on a journey where Mother Nature waits for “The Run” to arrive at their roots. Made at Global Game Jam, Pärnu, 2023, on the theme “Roots”.

games.title: Eat the Rich
games.blurb: A party card game about inequality. You are a PR manager hiding your rich client's dirty secrets, while the Hungry Crowd asks questions until someone ends up in the soup.
games.description: Made in a five-day game jam at the Un-Jam workshop, hosted by the Nordic Alliance for Sustainability in Gaming (NASG) in Copenhagen, by a team of five students from different backgrounds, on the theme “Sustainability”. The aim: draw attention to inequality, provoke discussion and ridicule the situation through a fun party game. You play a PR manager trying to hide the terrible truths about your rich client. The Hungry Crowd asks questions to bring the dirty secrets out, and finally throws your rich client into the soup.

games.title: Space Cricket
games.blurb: A cricket bat spinning in space. One tap flips its direction; time it to smash the right score and dodge the red stumps.
games.description: A simple casual game made for mobile. There is a bat in space and, unlike a normal cricket bat, it rotates constantly. A quick single tap changes the direction of rotation. The timing of your tap matters: swing the bat to hit the target colour score. Each colour bar represents a unique cricket score. Watch out for the nasty red stumps: hitting one loses you a wicket. Smashing a boundary unlocks exciting power-ups and earns trophies. So swing your bat carefully and aim for the boundary.

contributions.title: Game design
contributions.text: I loved designing this game because of its simplicity, and because it still hooks players who love a challenge. Balancing was also a fun part, as it involved many playtesting sessions.

games.title: Toony Car
games.blurb: An isometric car game with cute cars to unlock, each with its own ability.
games.description: An isometric casual car game with lots of cute cars to choose from. Each car has unique abilities, and unlocking them makes the game even more fun.

contributions.title: Game design
contributions.text: The most difficult yet satisfying part of designing this game was the economy system. It lets the player buy special cars, fuel and other items to make the game more fun and immersive.
bullets: Designed the game economy and virtual currency system

contributions.title: Game art
contributions.text: This was my first time creating a low-poly 3D environment. As it was intended for mobile, I had to keep the polycount very low, but I love that it turned out looking decent.
bullets: Texturing and baking assets optimised for mobile
